Titel: Interim Group Accounting Manager (m/f/d)
Unternehmen: Brightwater Logistics GmbH
Ort: Frankfurt Rhine-Main Metropolitan Area
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187300101/
Abgerufen am: 21.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Brightwater Logistics is a mid-sized contract logistics group with 23 subsidiaries in eleven countries. Following the acquisition of two warehousing businesses in Poland and the Czech Republic, our group accounting team needs experienced support on an interim basis.

What you will do
Own the preparation of the consolidated financial statements under IFRS for the 2026 year-end close
Integrate the newly acquired entities into the group reporting structure, including the purchase price allocation
Coordinate with the local finance teams and the group auditors
Improve the group reporting package and shorten the closing timeline

What we are looking for
You have spent several years in group accounting or in a Big Four audit role and feel at home with consolidation, intercompany eliminations and currency translation. Hands-on experience with LucaNet or SAP Group Reporting is a clear plus, and you are comfortable working in SAP S/4HANA. You communicate confidently in English; German is helpful but not required.

Engagement details
Start: 1 November 2026
Duration: 6 months, extension likely
Workload: full-time (5 days/week)
Daily rate: EUR 1,050 – 1,250 depending on experience
Location: remote with occasional on-site in Frankfurt (roughly one week per month, more during the year-end close)

Freelancers and interim managers only, this is not a permanent position.
